newsitem.title: CHINA: China urges state to buy cotton by Lunar New Year.
newsitem.headline: China urges state to buy cotton by Lunar New Year.

text.p: China has issued an urgent notice calling for an acceleration of cotton purchasing to boost farmers' incomes before the Chinese Lunar New Year, the People's Daily said on Thursday.

The All China Federation of Supply and Marketing Cooperatives urged offices throughout the country to make every effort to purchase cotton, it said. The federation buys cotton from farmers on behalf of the government.
Buying had been slow last year as production had fallen, it said.
The China Agriculture Development Bank had formulated measures to provide funds for offices short of purchasing funds, it said.
China's cotton output in 1996 was estimated at 4.0 million tonnes, down by 800,000 tonnes from the year before.
